answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive list of major **Sherlock Holmes Movies**, organized by era:

---

## 🎩 Sherlock Holmes Movies – Complete List by Era

---

### 🎞️ Silent Era (1900–1929)
Early films like *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* (1900) and *A Study in Scarlet* (1914) introduced Holmes to cinema.

| Year | Title |
|------|-------|
| 1900 | Sherlock Holmes Baffled |
| 1905 | Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; or, Held for Ransom |
| 1914 | A Study in Scarlet |
| 1916 | Sherlock Holmes (William Gillette) |
| 1922 | Sherlock Holmes (John Barrymore) |
| 1929 | The Return of Sherlock Holmes |

John Barrymore played the role in the 1922 movie *Sherlock Holmes*, with Roland Young as Watson and William Powell in his first screen appearance.

---

### 🔊 Early Talkies Era (1929–1937)
Arthur Wontner's series and films like *The Speckled Band* (1931) brought Holmes to the sound era, blending fidelity to the source material with modernized elements.

| Year | Title | Actor as Holmes |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1929 | The Return of Sherlock Holmes | Clive Brook |
| 1931 | The Speckled Band | Raymond Massey |
| 1931 | The Sleeping Cardinal | Arthur Wontner |
| 1932 | Sherlock Holmes | Clive Brook |
| 1933 | A Study in Scarlet | Reginald Owen |
| 1935 | The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes | Arthur Wontner |
| 1937 | Silver Blaze | Arthur Wontner |

Clive Brook played Sherlock Holmes three times: *The Return of Sherlock Holmes* (1929), as part of the anthology film *Paramount on Parade* (1930), and *Sherlock Holmes* (1932). Reginald Owen, who played Dr. Watson in the latter film, would portray Holmes the following year in *A Study in Scarlet*.

---

### 🎬 Basil Rathbone Era (1939–1946)
A series of fourteen films based on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes stories was released between 1939 and 1946; the British actors Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce played Holmes and Dr. John Watson, respectively. Basil Rathbone holds the record for portraying Sherlock Holmes in the most feature-length films, starring in 14 movies from 1939 to 1946.

| Year | Title |
|------|-------|
| 1939 | The Hound of the Baskervilles |
| 1939 | The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes |
| 1942 | Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror |
| 1942 | Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon |
| 1943 | Sherlock Holmes in Washington |
| 1943 | Sherlock Holmes Faces Death |
| 1944 | The Spider Woman |
| 1944 | The Scarlet Claw |
| 1944 | The Pearl of Death |
| 1945 | The House of Fear |
| 1945 | The Woman in Green |
| 1945 | Pursuit to Algiers |
| 1946 | Terror by Night |
| 1946 | Dressed to Kill |

The first two films in the series were produced by 20th Century Fox and released in 1939. The studio stopped making the films after these, but Universal Pictures acquired the rights from the Doyle estate and produced a further twelve films.

---

### 🏰 Hammer Film & Classic Era (1959–1984)

| Year | Title | Actor as Holmes |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1959 | The Hound of the Baskervilles | Peter Cushing |
| 1970 | The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes | Robert Stephens |
| 1975 | The Adventure of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother | Gene Wilder |
| 1976 | The Seven-Per-Cent Solution | Nicol Williamson |
| 1979 | Murder by Decree | Christopher Plummer |

### 🐭 Animation & Family (1985–1988)

We've had origin stories like *Young Sherlock Holmes* (1985), a Disneyfication in *The Great Mouse Detective* (1986), and a case of mistaken identity in *Without a Clue* (1988).

---

### 📺 TV Movies Era (1983–2004)

| Year | Title | Actor as Holmes |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| 1983 | The Sign of Four | Ian Richardson |
| 1983 | The Hound of the Baskervilles | Ian Richardson |
| 1991 | Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady | Christopher Lee |
| 1991 | Incident at Victoria Falls | Christopher Lee |
| 1991 | The Crucifer of Blood | Charlton Heston |
| 2002 | Case of Evil | James D'Arcy |
| 2004 | Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking | Rupert Everett |

The 1991–92 series *Sherlock Holmes the Golden Years* consisted of two TV films, in which Sherlock Holmes (played by Christopher Lee) and Dr. Watson (played by Patrick Macnee) are older adults who continue investigating cases. The two films were *Incident at Victoria Falls* and *Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady*.

---

### 🎬 Modern Era (2009–Present)

| Year | Title | Actor as Holmes |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| 2009 | Sherlock Holmes | Robert Downey Jr. |
| 2011 | Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows | Robert Downey Jr. |
| 2015 | Mr. Holmes | Ian McKellen |
| 2020 | Enola Holmes | Henry Cavill |
| 2022 | Enola Holmes 2 | Henry Cavill |

In *Mr. Holmes* (2015), an aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with dementia as he tries to remember his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him, directed by Bill Condon and starring Ian McKellen.

Robert Downey Jr. won a Golden Globe for his display as a dishevelled bohemian Holmes, who is handy with fists and faculties alike. Socially awkward and broodingly erratic, this Holmes is unsurprised by his brilliance but baffled as to why Watson (Jude Law) would want to give up the chase for domesticity.

---

> 🔍 **Fun Fact:** Sherlock Holmes is said to be one of the world's favourite characters for English-language films. The character has been portrayed on screen by dozens of actors across more than 120 years of cinema!
